hints.title: Separate the quantifier from the daily condition
hints.body: Write the statement as “for every day next week, P holds”. Its negation is “there is a day next week for which P fails”.
hints.recap: Negating a universal statement requires an exception within the same domain.
hints.pitfall: Now negate the daily condition too; changing only the word every is incomplete.
hints.pause: Express failure of the daily count using a nonnegative whole-number count, then compare the options.

recall.reminder: Negate the whole claim in stages and keep the original domain.

solution: The original claim fails exactly when there is at least one day next week on which Fred does no maths problems. Other days are unrestricted. Answer E.
